blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine Airlines (PAL) has finalized agreements with Boeing and GE Aerospace to purchase up to 20 Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner jets, marking the flag carrier’s first aircraft purchase from the American aviation giant since 2007. On November 10, officials signed follow-on agreements in Chicago, solidifying the initial commitments announced in July at the Farnborough International Airshow.
